# The Strategic Traveller

> The Strategic Traveller is a medical tourism facilitator that helps people in New Zealand get treatment at NABH or JCI-accredited hospitals in India. A New Zealand-based lead supports patients at home, before they leave and after they return, and a team in Delhi manages hospital, travel, and recovery logistics in India. We do not give medical advice; treatment decisions are made by the patient and their treating doctor.

Key facts:

- Direction of travel: from New Zealand to India and home again only. We do not arrange travel or retreats in New Zealand.
- Audience: people living in New Zealand seeking treatment in India (also patients from Australia and the Pacific), and hospitals, hotels, and care providers in India looking for a referral partner.
- Treatments coordinated: hip and knee replacement, spine surgery, cardiac surgery, cancer care and second opinions, IVF (at clinics registered under India's ART Act), organ transplant (under India's Transplantation of Human Organs and Tissues Act, 1994), eye surgery, dental treatment, and health check-ups.
- Hospital cities: Delhi NCR, Bengaluru, Chennai, and Mumbai.
- Indicative costs: treatment in India typically costs 55 to 85 percent less than private treatment in New Zealand; for example, a hip replacement is around NZD 10,000 to 14,000 in India versus NZD 30,000 to 40,000 privately in New Zealand. Flights and accommodation are extra. Written estimates in NZD are provided within 48 hours of receiving reports.
- Process: consent to share health information (New Zealand Privacy Act 2020 and Health Information Privacy Code; India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023), specialist review and written estimate, hospital letter and e-Medical Visa through the official Indian Visa Online portal, informed consent with the treating doctor, discharge records and GP handover in New Zealand.
- Not offered: surrogacy (not available to foreign nationals under India's Surrogacy (Regulation) Act, 2021) and paid or unrelated organ donors.
- Fees and any hospital referral commissions are disclosed to patients in writing.
- Contact: drvijayadutta@gmail.com

- [Best hospitals in India for New Zealand patients](https://thestrategictraveller.com/hospitals-in-india): hospitals by city and speciality, how hospitals are chosen, FAQs
- [Partner with us](https://thestrategictraveller.com/partners): partnerships for hospitals, hotels, recovery centres, transport, and care providers in India, and healthcare and travel partners in New Zealand
- [Ayurveda and recovery retreats](https://thestrategictraveller.com/wellness): Ayurveda, yoga, and post-surgery recovery retreats in India for people from New Zealand
